name: Grenade Launching Rifle
notes: AP rounds come from upgrades, not the base gun. Magazine comes from the rifle's marker buff (ModifyStack add-max 30). Verified in GameLab plan-t14.
primary: Slow, heavy round that pierces (560 ms, 160% damage, pierce 2). 1 round per shot, no mana.
secondary: Under-barrel grenade launcher: 4 mana, 1.5s cooldown, no rounds; splash for clearing low-HP mobs.
